scope: UX-04 operator presentation, mounted section navigation and draft preservation

tests.baseline: Operator queue filtering/paging and mission form
tests.implementation: Existing server filters, focus views and version-keyed forms plus edited-input guard
tests.positive: route-aware machinery requirements and evidence-aware supplier comparison work in the existing workspace
tests.negative: Cancel a queue filter change retains its current filter and actual unsaved requirement input

tests.baseline: Commercial requirements, quotation and source review
tests.implementation: In-context section focus/native disclosure without unmount; protected existing task switch
tests.positive: route-aware machinery requirements and evidence-aware supplier comparison work in the existing workspace
tests.negative: History navigation preserves input; cancelling task switch retains original form; real source and original quotation are preserved

tests.implementation: Context index and current-form acknowledgement/dirty protection
tests.positive: scoped delivery imports every row, serves client requests and downloads complete programme reports
tests.negative: Cancel programme change retains the old selection and programme draft; actual import, publication, denied scopes and exact CSV/PDF replay remain enforced

tests.baseline: Research, private relationships, identity and shortlist
tests.implementation: Contextual access to existing native sections and every original field
tests.positive: invited operator enrolls MFA, records provenance, manages flags and signs out
tests.negative: Original public/private distinctions and permission/review actions are retained; existing negative authorization checks remain required

tests.implementation: Existing controls grouped through stable in-context focus
tests.positive: controlled buyer response progresses through durable delivery, a held meeting and owned follow-up
tests.negative: Original recipient opt-out, source limits, proposed/held status and independent follow-up remain in the real service path

tests.baseline: Original commercial record and compensating history
tests.implementation: Existing record/history sections and original-currency values
tests.positive: operator follows the intake and held meeting through confirmed cash, recurrence, compensation and report replay
tests.negative: Independent reviewed confirmation/compensation, stale-session denial and historical event replay retain their actual contracts

limitations: Static control reconciliation is not runtime action/state coverage.
Unlinked whole-programme controls and inherited hosted identity lifecycle gaps remain NOT_YET_VERIFIED or PARTIAL.
No provider or real customer/financial operation is activated.
